findings.description: Step 7 of the skill tells the agent to propose AGENTS.md rule changes and skill changes, and says they 'merge before the next ticket starts' without naming who approves the merge. The inputs that drive these proposals are PR review comments from an automated reviewer and other third-party text, so a finding can steer what gets written into the rules that govern every later agent run.
findings.title: Agent may edit its own governing rules unreviewed

findings.description: The Board snippet looks up the item id with `--limit 200` and no check for an empty result, so `ITEM` is empty when the ticket is missing or beyond the first 200 items. The `item-edit` call then runs with an empty `--id` and the step gives no clear message that the card was not moved.
findings.title: Board update fails silently for tickets off the board

findings.description: The skill has the agent read the ticket body, comments and PR review comments with `gh` and then build tests, code and rule proposals from that text. Nothing tells the agent to treat this content as data rather than instructions, which matters when issue or PR comments can be written by people other than the maintainer.
findings.title: Ticket and PR text reaches the agent without a trust boundary
